name: teamhub-team
description: TeamHub Team Protocol — Team Lead / Developer / Tester / Project Planner skills for running a multi-agent Claude Code team (one human-driven Lead session plans and assigns work, Developer sessions write code, Tester sessions verify it and report bugs), backed by a self-hosted, project-aware TeamHub MCP server. Requires the teamhub MCP server running and wired into .mcp.json — see this plugin's README. Supports an optional auto/manual mode with real mid-task interrupt from the Lead.
